record.name: Project 6 — All-season road connections
record.description: Manitoba Transportation and Infrastructure proposes 141 km of public gravel highway linking the reserve boundaries of Manto Sipi, Bunibonibee and God’s Lake First Nations. Completed environmental assessment is not completed road construction; the provincial proponent is not presented as Nation ownership.
